questions.q: What is Mokrin House, which Tamara runs?
o: A rural space for shared living and working (co-living and co-working)
questions.e: In the video: "izvršna direktorka Mokrin Housea, koji je ruralni co-working i co-living prostor".

questions.q: How long do guests stay at Mokrin House on average?
questions.e: In the video: "borave kod nas tri dana, tri nedelje, tri meseca... u proseku nešto ispod tri nedelje".

questions.q: What professions were among the guests?
o: Not only programmers, but also poets, accountants, psychotherapists
questions.e: In the video: "Imali smo pesnike, imali smo računovođe, psihoterapeute koji rade svoj posao onlajn".

questions.q: What is the main difficulty of living at work?
o: There is no boundary between work and rest: they can call at any time
questions.e: In the video: "ja tehnički, kao, izađem iz kancelarije, ali zapravo ne izađem... neko će me pozvati u jedanaest, u dva ujutru".

questions.q: What two problems did Ctrip want to solve?
o: High rent in Shanghai and staff turnover
A shortage of clients and outdated computers
questions.e: In the video: "renta strašno visoka... imaju neverovatnu fluktuaciju zaposlenih".

questions.q: How was it chosen who would work from home?
o: By date of birth: even — at home, odd — in the office
questions.e: In the video: "svi koji su rođeni na parni datum će raditi od kuće, a ovi neparni će ostati u kancelariji".

questions.q: By how much did productivity grow for those who worked at home?
questions.e: In the video: "Njihova produktivnost je skočila za 13%".

questions.q: Why did half of the employees go back to the office anyway?
questions.e: In the video: "Glavni njihov razlog za povratak u kancelariju bio je usamljenost".

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Sve smo *omašili*.
questions.e: Omašiti — to miss, to make a mistake.

questions.q: Imamo radni prostor, *teretanu*, bazen i bicikle.
questions.e: Teretana — a gym.

questions.q: Neophodna je ljudska *prisnost* i fizički kontakt.
questions.e: Prisnost — closeness, intimacy.

questions.q: Imali su neverovatnu *fluktuaciju* zaposlenih.
questions.e: Fluktuacija — staff turnover.

questions.q: Prva ideja je bila: ljudi će da *bleje* od kuće.
questions.e: Blejati — colloquial "to laze around, to hang about".

questions.q: Imali su manje *ometanja*.
questions.e: Ometanje — a disturbance, a distraction.

questions.q: Za tih devet meseci ljudi su manje išli na *bolovanja*.
questions.e: Bolovanje — sick leave, being on sick leave.

questions.q: Glavni razlog za povratak bila je *usamljenost*.
questions.e: Usamljenost — loneliness; sam — alone.

questions.q: Hvala, Majo, na ovoj ___.
questions.e: Hvala na + locative case: na ovoj najavi.

questions.q: Preselila sam se sa Dorćola u ___.
questions.e: Preseliti se u + accusative case; for inanimate nouns it coincides with the nominative: u Mokrin.

questions.q: To je jedno selo pokraj ___.
questions.e: Pokraj ("next to") requires the genitive case: pokraj Kikinde.

questions.q: Imamo smeštajne ___.
questions.e: Imati + object — accusative plural: kapacitete.

questions.q: Spojili smo najbolje stvari ta dva ___.
questions.e: After dva the genitive singular is used: dva sveta.

questions.q: Imamo našu ___ i gajimo koke, patke i guske.
questions.e: Imati + object — accusative case: baštu.

questions.q: Ja živim iza ovih ___.
questions.e: Iza ("behind") requires the genitive case; vrata — genitive plural: iza ovih vrata.

questions.q: Stanfordski profesor je iskoristio jednu kinesku ___.
questions.e: Iskoristiti + object — accusative case: kompaniju.
